# xg2g canonical timing publication corpus, format version 1
#
# A case defines an MPEG-TS stream and the exact canonical timeline
# publication that Rust media-core must emit and Go remotecore must decode.
version 1

case canonical_timeline_lifecycle
  desc authoritative multi-step stream verifying canonical timing publication across protocol v6
  program 1
  # PAT arrives before any PMT: program identity changes, epoch is deactivated
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=0 before=none after=none
  # First PMT accepted: establishes Epoch 0 and emits program identity discontinuity
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=188 before=none after=0
  # PCR-first arrives: sets initial epoch phase reference
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pcr epoch=0 pid=256 pcr=27000000 obs=376
  # Video PES with PTS+DTS and IDR slice: emits RAP bound to PTS
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event rap offset=564 joinable=1
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=90000 dts=86400 obs=564 sub=564
  record rap epoch=0 pid=257 pts=90000 dts=86400 obs=564 sub=564
  # Video PES with PTS only and non-IDR slice
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=93600 dts=none obs=752 sub=752
  # Video PES with B-frame negative delta relative to anchor
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=86400 dts=none obs=940 sub=940
  # Provisional RAP followed by TEI in same AU invalidates RAP and reports track reset
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event rap offset=1128 joinable=1
  event rap_invalidated offset=1128
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=90000 dts=none obs=1128 sub=1128
  record rap epoch=0 pid=257 pts=90000 dts=none obs=1128 sub=1128
  record disc scope=track:257 reason=transport_timing_loss obs=1316 before=0 after=0
  # DI without PCR on PCR PID advances epoch from 0 to 1
  chunk 
  epoch 1
  record disc scope=program reason=pcr_discontinuity_indicator obs=1504 before=0 after=1
  # Next clean PCR sample remains in epoch 1 with no second discontinuity
  chunk 
  epoch 1
  record pcr epoch=1 pid=256 pcr=54000000 obs=1692
  # DI and PCR in same packet advances epoch from 1 to 2 and records sample directly in epoch 2
  chunk 
  epoch 2
  record disc scope=program reason=pcr_discontinuity_indicator obs=1880 before=1 after=2
  record pcr epoch=2 pid=256 pcr=81000000 obs=1880
  # In new epoch, video PES with DTS arrives before PCR and establishes phase reference
  chunk 
  epoch 2
  record pes epoch=2 pid=257 pts=270000 dts=266400 obs=2068 sub=2068
  # Video packet CC jump triggers track-local reset without advancing epoch
  chunk 
  epoch 2
  record disc scope=track:257 reason=transport_timing_loss obs=2256 before=2 after=2
  record pes epoch=2 pid=257 pts=270000 dts=none obs=2256 sub=2256
  # PMT version increment advances epoch from 2 to 3
  chunk 
  epoch 3
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=2444 before=2 after=3
  # Audio packet CC jump triggers audio track-local reset without advancing epoch
  chunk 
  epoch 3
  record disc scope=track:258 reason=transport_timing_loss obs=2820 before=3 after=3
end

case pts_wrap_33bit
  desc verifies seamless 33-bit PTS unrolling across modulus boundary
  program 1
  # PAT for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=0 before=none after=none
  # PMT for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=188 before=none after=0
  # Video PES near 33-bit boundary (2^33 - 500)
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=8589934092 dts=none obs=376 sub=376
  # Video PES wraps across 2^33 boundary to raw 500: correctly unrolls to 2^33 + 500
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=8589935092 dts=none obs=564 sub=564
end

case pcr_wrap_27mhz
  desc verifies seamless 27 MHz PCR unrolling across modulus boundary
  program 1
  # PAT for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=0 before=none after=none
  # PMT for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=188 before=none after=0
  # PCR near 27 MHz boundary
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pcr epoch=0 pid=256 pcr=2576980374600 obs=376
  # PCR wraps across 27 MHz boundary to raw 3000: correctly unrolls to modulus + 3000
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pcr epoch=0 pid=256 pcr=2576980380600 obs=564
end

case re_anchor_beyond_half_modulus
  desc verifies track re-anchoring beyond 13.25h aligns against phase reference without jumping backward
  program 1
  # PAT for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=0 before=none after=none
  # PMT for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=188 before=none after=0
  # Stream origin at PTS 0
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=0 dts=none obs=376 sub=376
  # Stream progresses to 3,000,000,000 ticks (~9.25h)
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=3000000000 dts=none obs=564 sub=564
  # Stream progresses beyond M/2 to 5,000,000,000 ticks (~15.4h)
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=5000000000 dts=none obs=752 sub=752
  # CC jump resets track: subsequent sample re-anchors against dynamic phase reference, NOT origin 0
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record disc scope=track:257 reason=transport_timing_loss obs=940 before=0 after=0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=5000003600 dts=none obs=940 sub=940
end

case rap_established_at_access_unit_end
  desc an all-intra RAP established chunks after its PES header is published bound in the chunk that establishes it
  program 1
  # PAT arrives before any PMT
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=0 before=none after=none
  # PMT establishes Epoch 0
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=188 before=none after=0
  # All-intra access unit starts: SPS, PPS, non-IDR slice with slice_type I - no RAP yet
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=180000 dts=176400 obs=376 sub=376
  # The access unit continues in its own chunk
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  # Next PES ends the all-intra access unit: RAP at 376 is established here and published bound to its own PES timing
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event rap offset=376 joinable=1
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=183600 dts=none obs=752 sub=752
  record rap epoch=0 pid=257 pts=180000 dts=176400 obs=752 sub=376
end

case canonical_timeline_zap_lifecycle
  desc verifies canonical closing edge publication at first transport packet across zaps and multi-zaps
  program 1
  # PAT for program 1: program identity changes, epoch deactivated
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=0 before=none after=none
  # PMT for program 1: mints Epoch 0
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=188 before=none after=0
  # PCR for program 1
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  record pcr epoch=0 pid=256 pcr=27000000 obs=376
  # Video PES with IDR for program 1: publishes bound RAP
  chunk 
  epoch 0
  event rap offset=564 joinable=1
  record pes epoch=0 pid=257 pts=90000 dts=86400 obs=564 sub=564
  record rap epoch=0 pid=257 pts=90000 dts=86400 obs=564 sub=564
  # Control plane zap 1 -> 2: latches pending closing edge for epoch 0, emits identity event
  settarget 2
  event identity
  # Empty ingest chunk: edge stays pending, 0 records emitted, epoch none
  chunk
  epoch none
  # Idempotent reselect 2: no events, closing edge remains pending
  settarget 2
  # First transport packet after zap (PAT for program 2): emits pending closing edge for epoch 0
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=752 before=0 after=none
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=752 before=none after=none
  # PMT for program 2: mints Epoch 1
  chunk 
  epoch 1
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=940 before=none after=1
  # Multi-zap: settarget 3 latches closing edge for epoch 1
  settarget 3
  event identity
  # Multi-zap: settarget 4 preserves existing pending closing edge for epoch 1
  settarget 4
  event identity
  # First transport packet after multi-zap (PAT for program 4): emits single closing edge for epoch 1
  chunk 
  epoch none
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=1128 before=1 after=none
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=1128 before=none after=none
  # PMT for program 4: mints Epoch 2
  chunk 
  epoch 2
  event identity
  record disc scope=program reason=program_identity_changed obs=1316 before=none after=2
end
